notes.content: [h3]📢 Patch Notes – Fake Customers Are Here![/h3][p]Things just got trickier in [b]Smuggler City Simulator[/b]![/p][p]With this update, [b]fake customers[/b] can now walk into your office. They act like real buyers, but don’t be fooled—they might be testing you... Better think twice before making that deal.[/p][p]🔍 [b]What’s New?[/b][/p][list][*][p]🚶‍♂️ [b]Fake Customer System Added[/b] – Spotting the difference is now part of the challenge[/p][/*][*][p]💼 Increased office traffic and more interaction options[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 Minor bug fixes and performance improvements[/p][/*][/list][p]Business in Smuggler City just got riskier... good luck![/p]

notes.title: Smuggler City Simulator Early Demo Hot Fix V0.3
notes.content:
[h2]🛠️ Major Update: Bargaining System Overhaul + New Sound Effects![/h2][p]Hey everyone! 🎮[/p][p]We’re excited to roll out a new update that brings major improvements to core systems along with fresh content for a more immersive gameplay experience.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔊 [b]New Sound Effects for a Livelier Experience![/b][/h3][list][*][p]We've added a variety of [b]new sound effects[/b] to the buying and selling processes.[/p][/*][*][p]Expect to hear [b]horns, customer reactions, and cash handling sounds[/b] during negotiations and transactions.[/p][/*][*][p]All audio is carefully balanced to match the atmosphere and enhance realism.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🤝 [b]Bargaining System Reworked from the Ground Up[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Customers now [b]react to overpriced offers[/b] with surprise or even refusal.[/p][/*][*][p]Pricing decisions are now more [b]realistic and dynamic[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The chances of a successful bargain now depend on how close your offer is to the buyer's expected price range.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes & System Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where customers would accept absurdly high prices.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved bugs related to the sales panel, inventory updates, and price mismatches.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📌 Coming Soon[/h3][list][*][p]New customer animations[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded inventory features[/p][/*][*][p]Regional economic mechanics[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Your feedback keeps the game growing – don’t hesitate to share your thoughts in the Steam discussions! 💬
Happy trading and good luck making those big sales! 🤑📱[/p][p][b]– Reylor Games[/b][/p]
